question: Prepare realized-funding attribution for the frozen 680-contract NAV-tenth account without changing its historical orders or NAV.
network_policy: preflight and mini are local-read-only; only explicit --collect may fetch sources

account.selection: trend_efficiency full runner when causal directional efficiency > 0.5, otherwise 2/3 scaleout

contract_universe.policy: Read the already-built native path rows for 632 base contracts, 29 earlier archive additions and 11 supplemental contracts with a complete prior-90d path. The other 8 metadata contracts remain in the declared 680 but are excluded by the frozen 90-day eligibility gate.

path_sources.account_join_key: funded_tenth.event_id = native_path.event_id; each actual event retains parent_id from the original 12H signal
path_sources.selection_clock: entry_ms and the same pre-key H1 observations used in the frozen trend_efficiency selection

accounting.cash_pnl_formula: side * (exit_price - entry_price) * abs(signed_quantity) - entry_notional * 0.0005 - exit_notional * exit_fee_rate

outputs.preflight: In-memory path join, fee-class, parent-notional and cash-PnL checks only; writes no artifacts.
outputs.mini: Synthetic 2/3 child sizing, maker/taker cash reconciliation and phase-aware window check; writes no artifacts.
outputs.collect: After commit checks, atomically writes independent execution_legs.csv.gz, then invokes the shared funding writer to generate current settlement outputs and its final audit receipt.

limits: This adapter reconstructs fixed actual child-leg quantities and native exits for funding attribution; it does not re-run VectorBT account admission or recompute the historical NAV.
No API request, archive download, funding cashflow calculation or persistent output is performed by preflight or mini. Collection is a separate explicit network operation.
The eight supplemental contracts without a complete 90-day native history remain excluded from funded events under the frozen eligibility policy.

The independent execution-leg table is the authoritative join for entry/exit prices, phases, fees, size, stop and same-bar ambiguity; settlement outputs are joined by event_id and tp_r without post-write mutation.
funding_source_note: Read the official USD-M monthly fundingRate archive and markPriceKlines archives, reusing local exact funding API marks when their original settlement timestamp matches. The earlier API pass returned repeated HTTP 403 for most held windows; the independent official bulk files were verified available in 2020, 2022, 2025 and 2026. Do not repeat failed per-window REST calls.
